annotations.title: Look up a company's federal profile

description:
One company in one call: federal money by year (all its registrations rolled up), top
    agencies, industries, places and largest awards, SAM.gov registration (expiry, size and
    certifications), exclusions, state payments and a short brief, each section with its
    answer and first rows, and its spendquery.com page. Uses the page as built for the site
    when there is one (fast), else builds it (5-15 s).

company.description: A company UEI (12 characters, e.g. "YMZ1PCB5LEM9"), name or ticker, e.g. "Leidos".
